source_title: Berufliche Schulen sollen zu Innovationstreibern für digitales und KI-gestütztes Lernen werden
title_zh: 職業學校應成為數位與 AI 支持學習的創新推手
source_organization: Bildungsministerkonferenz der KMK（德國各邦教育部長會議）
original_excerpt: Berufliche Schulen sollen die Potenziale Künstlicher Intelligenz (KI) gezielt für die Entwicklung innovativer Unterrichtskonzepte und zeitgemäße Prüfungen nutzen. Die Bildungsministerkonferenz (BMK) und das Bundesbildungsministerium stellen dazu zehn Handlungsempfehlungen des Paktes für berufliche Schulen vor. … Die Amtschefskonferenz Bildung hat den Handlungsempfehlungen am 12. November 2026 in Berlin zugestimmt. … Der Rat für den Pakt für berufliche Schulen hat die Empfehlungen des zweiten Arbeitszyklus am 29. September 2026 beschlossen. … Entsprechend den vereinbarten organisatorischen Eckpunkten wurden sie anschließend unmittelbar der Amtschefskonferenz Bildung vorgelegt und sollen nun von den Paktpartnern umgesetzt werden. … Handlungsempfehlungen zweiter Arbeitszyklus „Schul- und Unterrichtsentwicklung an beruflichen Schulen mit Digitalisierung und KI weiterentwickeln“ … Lehrende sowie Lernende setzen insbesondere KI reflektiert und bedarfsgerecht ein (z. B. KI als persönlicher Lerntutor oder beim kollaborativen Lernen). Der soziale Raum und das gemeinsame Lernen bleiben gleichermaßen relevant. … Grundlage zukunftsfähiger Bildung für eine digitale, KI-geprägte Arbeitswelt ist ein länderübergreifender, verbindlicher Kompetenzrahmen. … Die Anforderungen durch Digitalisierung und KI umfassen insbesondere die digitale Mündigkeit der Schülerinnen und Schüler sowie die kritische Reflexion digitaler, insbesondere KI-gesteuerter Arbeits- und Geschäftsprozesse (inklusive ethischer Fragen). … Hierzu sind zeitnah Modellprojekte zu initiieren und wissenschaftlich zu begleiten, um bewährte Ansätze zügig in die Fläche zu bringen. … Zeitgemäße Prüfungsformate lassen Mensch-Maschine-Interaktion explizit zu und machen gleichzeitig individuelle menschliche Kompetenzen messbar und zurechenbar. … Mindestanforderung ist dabei, dass die Lernenden über ein digitales Endgerät verfügen und einen gleichförmigen Zugriff auf KI-Systeme haben. … Benötigt wird eine souveräne, datenschutzkonforme und skalierbare KI-Infrastruktur für berufliche Schulen mit einem barrierefreien und kostenlosen Zugang für Lehrkräfte und Lernende. … Hierzu verständigen sich die zuständigen Paktpartner auf eine Zertifizierung (u. a. zur DSGVO-Konformität) und einen Prüfmechanismus, der die Anbieter der Lernanwendungen in die Pflicht nimmt und zugleich die beruflichen Schulen entlastet.
claim_text: 來源機構：Bildungsministerkonferenz der KMK（德國各邦教育部長會議）；資料標題：Berufliche Schulen sollen zu Innovationstreibern für digitales und KI-gestütztes Lernen werden；來源刊登日：2026-11-16。內容：德國各邦教育首長會議（BMK）與德國聯邦教育主管部會 11 月 16 日提出「職業學校協約」（Pakt für berufliche Schulen）第二工作循環的十項行動建議，主題為以數位化與 AI 發展職業學校的學校與教學；建議由協約理事會 2026 年 9 月 29 日決議，Amtschefskonferenz Bildung 11 月 12 日同意，將由協約夥伴落實。新聞稿表示，職業學校應有目的地運用 AI 的潛力，發展創新教學構想與符合時代的考試。建議文件中與 AI 直接相關的條目包括：教師與學習者有反思且依需求地運用 AI（例如作為個人學習導師或用於協作學習），社會空間與共同學習同樣重要；以跨邦、具約束力的能力框架為基礎，數位化與 AI 帶來的要求特別包括學生的數位自主，以及對 AI 驅動的工作與業務流程的批判反思（含倫理問題）；符合時代的考試形式明確允許人機互動，同時使個人能力可衡量、可歸屬，並盡快啟動有科學陪伴的試點計畫；學習者至少應有數位裝置並能同等取用 AI 系統，並需要主權、符合資料保護、對教師與學習者免費且無障礙的 AI 基礎設施；協約夥伴就數位工具的認證（含一般資料保護規則合規）與審查機制達成共識，讓職業學校教師使用時有法律確定性。說明：本文件為協約夥伴的行動建議，不是法規；對象為職業學校（以中等職業教育為主，亦含部分中學後進修學校）。（AI 輔助整理，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）

source_title: Lesson plan: AI and your coursework (accessible)
title_zh: 教案：AI 與你的課程作業（無障礙版）
source_organization: 英國資格與考試監管署（Ofqual）
original_excerpt: PSHE/ tutor time, or subject lesson with a non-exam assessment component … Year 10 to 13, students undertaking GCSE or A Level coursework (non-exam assessment) … 50 minutes, adaptable to a form period or subject lesson … The risks of using AI in coursework and the value of building the underlying skills and knowledge yourself … know that using AI to produce any part of their coursework puts their whole qualification at risk, not just the coursework mark … understand that even if AI use isn’t detected, it still costs them the understanding that coursework is meant to build … be able to explain why a grade only has value if it reflects what they can actually do … know what to do if they’re tempted to use AI, or have already used it, before submission … Ask students: “What do you think you’d actually lose if you used AI to do your coursework for you?” … Using AI to do coursework is risky in two ways: … Students often raise the same handful of arguments. … if you’re stuck or unsure how to approach something, talk to your teacher, that’s what they’re there for … if you’ve already used AI in your coursework, speak to your teacher now. It’s easier before submission than a malpractice investigation afterwards … 4. Possible activity - Can you trust the information? (20 minutes) … The key learning point is that information can appear convincing even when it contains errors. … This research was conducted overseas and in a different education system, so it isn’t a direct prediction for any individual student, but the pattern it describes, a quiet build-up of lost understanding, is the same risk this lesson is asking students to think about.
claim_text: 來源機構：英國資格與考試監管署（Ofqual）；資料標題：Lesson plan: AI and your coursework (accessible)；來源刊登日：2026-11-18。內容：英國資格與考試監管署（Ofqual）11 月 18 日在〈AI in coursework: resources for schools〉頁面新增給學校使用的教案，同時新增海報、集會簡報與家長通訊稿文字，並撤下 3 月版教案；適用範圍為英格蘭。教案時長 50 分鐘，可用於 PSHE、導師時間或含非考試評量的科目課，對象為進行 GCSE 或 A Level 課程作業（非考試評量）的 10 至 13 年級學生，主題是在課程作業中使用 AI 的風險，以及自己建立基礎技能與知識的價值。學習目標有四項：知道以 AI 產出課程作業任何部分會使整個資格面臨風險，而不只是課程作業分數；理解即使 AI 使用未被發現，仍會失去課程作業要培養的理解；能說明成績只有反映自己實際能力時才有價值；知道若想使用 AI 或已經使用時，在繳交前該怎麼做。課堂流程依序為：先問學生若用 AI 做課程作業「實際上會失去什麼」；說明使用 AI 的雙重風險，並回應學生常提出的反駁；最後總結要點，包括不確定時找老師談，已在課程作業中使用 AI 者現在就告訴老師。教案另附 20 分鐘的選用活動，請學生判斷一張含正確、錯誤與無法查證敘述的資料單，教師說明的重點是資訊即使有錯也可能顯得可信。說明：教案引述一項海外研究，並註明該研究在不同教育體系進行，本則未轉述其結果。（AI 輔助整理，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）

source_title: Using without understanding: AI literacy and trust in large language models among elementary school children in Germany
title_zh: 會用但不懂：德國小學兒童的 AI 素養與對大型語言模型的信任
source_organization: Journal of Children and Media（Taylor & Francis）
original_excerpt: children aged 8-10 years participated in semi-structured interviews combined with an interaction task using a customized LLM. Children used the system competently, yet their conceptual understanding remained fragmented. … Their reasoning was frequently anthropomorphic, reinforced by social cues such as natural language use and emojis. … Children explained the system’s errors through human fallibility, but most considered algorithmic bias impossible, treating prejudice as a uniquely human trait. … Semi-structured interviews were used to explore children’s thoughts and experiences with AI, providing direct engagement and rich, first-hand data. … For this purpose, a customized version of ChatGPT (model GPT-4, OpenAI) was created. … The system was additionally assigned the human name Lana, an intentional design decision to make it accessible to the children and to foster a natural interaction, analogous to commercial conversational systems children encounter in everyday life. … The guide consisted of 55 mainly open-ended questions. … Additionally, the interview guide included eight closed-ended items answered on a 5-point scale … Data collection took place between February and June 2025. All sessions were conducted individually in a familiar school room to ensure a comfortable learning environment. With informed consent from participants and their legal guardians, all sessions were audio-recorded. Sessions lasted 34 minutes on average (range 21–59 minutes). … children completed a short research task in which they investigated how an animal of their choice lives during winter (see Figure 1). … To ensure accessibility, children dictated their prompts aloud while the researcher typed. … The study was preregistered on the Open Science Framework (OSF; https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/RVSYZ), where supplementary materials are also available … Thirty children aged 8–10 years (M = 9.03, SD = 0.77) participated in the study. … Participants were recruited in collaboration with an elementary school in an urban area in western Germany. The school provides regular computer instruction, but AI was not part of the curriculum, so children’s prior experience with AI stemmed from outside of school. The final sample included 15 girls and 15 boys from four third- and fourth-grade classes. … were analyzed using structured qualitative content analysis according to Mayring (2015). … Quantitative items from the interviews (5-point Likert scales) were evaluated descriptively to complement the qualitative findings. … Most children (n = 23) were aware that the LLM could produce incorrect information. … In sharp contrast to their awareness of the other risks, most children (n = 24) could not imagine that the LLM might be biased. … Perceived benevolence was highest across all dimensions. … Trust in integrity showed the greatest variation. … trust in truthfulness was high, whereas trust in confidentiality was substantially lower. … and structure of reasoning within the sample studied rather than population-level distributions. Quantitative studies with larger, more diverse samples are needed to examine how the patterns identified here are distributed among children in this age … Because no data on the children’s ethnocultural or socioeconomic backgrounds were collected, the findings cannot contextualize differential access to AI-related experiences and adult guidance. … Although the interview guide was piloted and no signs of fatigue were observed, an influence of interview length on individual responses cannot be ruled out. In addition, the single information-seeking task foregrounded the system’s informational ability, so judgments of benevolence and integrity may be context-dependent and should be examined across varied interaction scenarios. … A further limitation concerns the design of the study system. The LLM was deliberately given a human name to foster a natural interaction. This choice may have contributed to the anthropomorphic responses observed, and, within the present design, its specific effect cannot be isolated from that of other social cues, such as natural language use and emojis.
claim_text: 來源機構：Journal of Children and Media（Taylor & Francis）；資料標題：Using without understanding: AI literacy and trust in large language models among elementary school children in Germany；來源刊登日：2026-11-18。樣本：作者報告 30 名 8–10 歲兒童參與研究（女、男各 15 人），經由德國西部都市地區一所小學招募，來自該校四個三、四年級班級；該校有固定的電腦課，但 AI 不在課程內，兒童的 AI 經驗來自校外。設計：作者稱以半結構訪談結合與客製化大型語言模型的互動任務進行質性研究；資料於 2025 年 2 月至 6 月在學校熟悉的教室逐一蒐集並錄音，平均 34 分鐘。研究者以 GPT-4 建立取名「Lana」的客製化 ChatGPT（作者稱取人名是有意的設計），兒童口述提示、研究者打字，完成查詢一種動物如何過冬的小任務；訪談指引含 55 題、以開放題為主，另有 8 題五點量表題。訪談以 Mayring 的結構化質性內容分析編碼，量表題只作描述性分析；研究已在 OSF 預先登錄。作者所述發現：作者報告，兒童能熟練使用系統，但概念理解零散；推理常帶擬人化，並受自然語言與表情符號等社交線索強化；多數兒童（23 人）知道系統可能產出錯誤資訊，並以人會犯錯來解釋，但多數（24 人）無法想像系統可能有偏誤，視偏見為人類獨有的特質。信任方面，兒童對系統善意的評價在各維度中最高，對誠信的判斷差異最大：對誠實的信任高，對保密的信任明顯較低。以上為作者對受訪兒童的描述。限制：作者自述結果呈現受訪樣本中的推理樣態，而非母群分布，須以較大且較多元的量化樣本檢視；未蒐集兒童的族群文化與社經背景資料；無法排除訪談長度對個別回答的影響；單一資訊查詢任務凸顯系統的資訊能力，對善意與誠信的判斷可能因情境而異；系統刻意取人名以促成自然互動，可能促成所觀察到的擬人化反應，且在本設計中無法與其他社交線索的作用區分。（AI 輔助整理，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）

original_excerpt: This study reports the development and initial validation of a GenAI stress scale tailored to Chinese K-12 teachers (T-GenAISS). … Exploratory analysis on a randomly split half of 612 teachers (174 pre-service and 438 in-service) affiliated with an Alliance of Thinking Schools professional learning community (n = 306) suggested seven dimensions: Privacy Violation, Job Replacement, Professional Development, Against Ethics, Lack of Transparency, Technological Dependence, and Bias Behavior. … Data were collected from the Alliance of Thinking Schools (ATS) (Long et al., 2021; Zhao et al., 2019, 2023), a professional learning community on teaching thinking for K-12 teachers in China, from March 2025 to June 2025. Since 2023, GenAI tools and GenAIenhanced teaching of thinking were included in the ATS teacher training. … Purposive sampling was used. An online questionnaire including the consent form and questionnaire link was sent to potential participants, who were ATS members and had participated in the AI training, via WeChat group. A total of 661 teachers completed the questionnaire anonymously and voluntarily. … Forty-nine responses were eliminated for a response time of less than 90 s or more than 900 s. In total, 612 valid responses were retained, yielding a valid response rate of 92.6%. … The sample is therefore best described as ATS-affiliated pre-service and in-service teachers rather than as a representative sample of Chinese K-12 teachers. … The second part comprised 65 items measuring teachers’ GenAI stress. … Confirmatory factor analysis on the other half (n = 306) yielded a mixed pattern … The evidence is therefore described throughout as initial rather than as establishing a validated measure, and the substantive findings reported with the instrument are correspondingly provisional. … The finding that Lack of Transparency Stress is the most salient concern … indicates that respondents endorsed statements about occupational displacement less strongly than statements about the other six dimensions. … the confirmatory model required eight post hoc residual covariances and was evaluated on the same data that motivated them, so the reported fit is optimistic and independent replication in a new sample is needed before the structure can be regarded as confirmed … the Job Replacement dimension fell below the AVE criterion (AVE = 0.462) … Technological Dependence rests on two items, which limits content breadth and makes the factor weakly identified; content validity was established through formative expert review without computation of I-CVI or S-CVI; and the instrument was translated into Chinese without blind back-translation … the sample consisted of ATS-affiliated pre-service and in-service teachers who had received GenAI training, which restricts generalizability to Chinese K-12 teachers at large and plausibly biases mean levels … the analyses were cross-sectional and self-reported, which precludes causal inference and may introduce method variance … no external criterion variables were measured … the present data were collected before agentic tools became widely adopted

original_excerpt: 真正的素養在於正用AI，即具備後設思考能力，能反思AI的偏見與限制，並將AI觀點與學生觀點辯證整合，形成獨立判斷。 … 學生不僅需要理解技術的運作與限制，也要能在與系統互動的過程中形成自己的觀點與決策。 … 學生AI素養的培養是實現AI教育願景的基石，學生需要具備以人為中心的價值觀，理解AI的基本特性、應用範疇及其對社會的影響，並發展批判思考與倫理判斷能力。
claim_text: 來源機構：中華民國教育部；資料標題：臺灣中小學教師與學生AI素養框架；來源刊登日：2026-04-17。官方文件表示：框架的學生 AI 素養一章寫明，真正的素養在於正用 AI，即具備後設思考能力，能反思 AI 的偏見與限制，並將 AI 觀點與學生觀點辯證整合，形成獨立判斷；學生不僅需要理解技術的運作與限制，也要能在與系統互動的過程中形成自己的觀點與決策。學生 AI 素養結語寫明，學生需要具備以人為中心的價值觀，理解 AI 的基本特性、應用範疇及其對社會的影響，並發展批判思考與倫理判斷能力。說明：日期為文件所印核定日（臺教資（一）字第 1152701134 號），本刊未找到教育部公告頁；文件封面印 2026 年 3 月。（臺灣對照，非本週新訊；AI 輔助整理，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）
